AnalyticsPage.winRateInfo: Deals closed this period, won vs lost. Center = win rate (won ÷ won+lost).
AnalyticsPage.activityInfo: Logged activities by type over the period, dated by timestamp.
AnalyticsPage.teamInfo: Members ranked by logged activity: activities, completed tasks, and notes.
AnalyticsPage.agingInfo: Open deals by stage and time since last update. Fresh < 7 days, stalled > 60.
AnalyticsPage.topDealsInfo: Biggest open deals by expected value; biggest wins by actual value.
AnalyticsPage.pipelineValueInfo: Won revenue this period plus current open value, per pipeline. Ranked by total; empty pipelines hidden.
AnalyticsPage.emptyBody: As you add deals and log activity, this page fills in with revenue trends, win rates, pipeline value, and team momentum.
AnalyticsPage.warmthInfo: Contacts and companies by warmth band (hot / warm / cool / cold), scored from interaction recency and frequency. Trend counts contacts rising, steady, or cooling.
AnalyticsPage.decayInfo: Still-warm contacts predicted to go cold if untouched, grouped by how soon. Based on the decay forecast, not deals.
AnalyticsPage.dealRiskInfo: Open deals the risk engine flags, by severity and contributing factor. Value is total expected value at risk in the selected currency.
AnalyticsPage.taskStatusSubtitle: Across every open and closed task
AnalyticsPage.taskStatusInfo: Tasks by Kanban column (to do, in progress, done). Center shows the share done.
AnalyticsPage.introsInfo: Suggested introductions you're positioned to make, and introductions actually logged over the selected period.
AnalyticsPage.movesInfo: Contacts who recently changed companies — a champion who moves is a warm lead at their new account.
